rule: Stereocentres that are not part of the reaction keep the handedness they have in the reactant.
name: chirality

rule: Atoms that are stereocentres in the product already have the product's handedness at the transition state.
name: product_stereo

rule: Atoms that are never bonded to each other, in the reactant or the product, are not squashed unrealistically close together.
name: clash

rule: Bonds that survive the reaction keep a length close to their lengths in the reactant and product.
name: spectator_bonds

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Bonds present in both reactant and product keep lengths close to their reactant/product values."""
    changed = set(tuple(sorted(b)) for b in rxn.changed_bonds)
    shared = [b for b in rxn.reactant_bonds if b in rxn.product_bonds and b not in changed]
    if not shared:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    worst = None
    for (i, j) in shared:
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp)
        # bonds at the reaction centre may change order and stretch more
        centre = i in rxn.reaction_centre or j in rxn.reaction_centre
        tol_lo = 0.30 if centre else 0.20
        tol_hi = 0.45 if centre else 0.30
        if d < lo - tol_lo:
            excess = lo - d
        elif d > hi + tol_hi:
            excess = d - hi
        else:
            continue
        if worst is None or excess > worst[0]:
            worst = (excess, i, j, d, lo, hi)
    if worst is not None:
        _, i, j, d, lo, hi = worst
        return False, (f"{rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A "
                       f"(reactant/product range {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f} A)")
    return True, "all surviving bonds are close to their reactant/product lengths"

rule: Bonds that form or break have lengths in between their reactant and product values.
name: reacting_bonds

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Each forming/breaking bond has a TS length between its reactant and product lengths (with a tolerance)."""
    if not rxn.changed_bonds:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    tol = 0.35
    for i, j in rxn.changed_bonds:
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp)
        if d < lo - tol or d > hi + tol:
            return False, (f"{rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A in the TS, "
                           f"outside reactant {dr:.2f} / product {dp:.2f} A (tolerance {tol} A)")
    return True, "all changing bonds lie between reactant and product lengths"

rule: Double bonds and aromatic rings that do not take part in the reaction stay flat.
name: planarity

rule: A hydrogen that moves from one heavy atom to another sits between them at the transition state, closer to the line joining them than to either end.
name: h_transfer

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """A transferring hydrogen lies between its donor and acceptor atoms, near the line joining them."""
    nr = rxn.neighbours('reactant')
    npd = rxn.neighbours('product')
    found = False
    for h in range(rxn.n):
        if rxn.atoms[h] != 1:
            continue
        donors = [d for d in nr.get(h, []) if rxn.atoms[d] != 1 and d not in npd.get(h, [])]
        accs = [a for a in npd.get(h, []) if rxn.atoms[a] != 1 and a not in nr.get(h, [])]
        if not donors or not accs:
            continue
        found = True
        best = None
        for d in donors:
            for a in accs:
                v = xyz[a] - xyz[d]
                L2 = float(np.dot(v, v))
                if L2 < 1e-6:
                    continue
                w = xyz[h] - xyz[d]
                t = float(np.dot(w, v)) / L2
                perp = float(np.linalg.norm(w - t * v))
                dh = float(np.linalg.norm(w))
                ah = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[h] - xyz[a]))
                ok = (-0.1 <= t <= 1.1) and perp < 0.9 * min(dh, ah)
                info = (ok, f"H{h + 1} between {rxn.symbols[d]}{d + 1} and {rxn.symbols[a]}{a + 1}: "
                            f"off-line distance {perp:.2f} A, projection t={t:.2f}, "
                            f"d(H-donor)={dh:.2f}, d(H-acceptor)={ah:.2f}")
                if ok:
                    best = info
                    break
                if best is None:
                    best = info
            if best is not None and best[0]:
                break
        if best is not None and not best[0]:
            return False, best[1]
    if not found:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    return True, "transferring hydrogens sit between donor and acceptor"

def check(rxn, xyz):
    """A transferring hydrogen stays close to both its donor and acceptor, with a D-H-A angle that is not collapsed."""
    nr = rxn.neighbours('reactant')

        accs = [a for a in npd.get(h, []) if rxn.atoms[a] != 1 and a not in nr.get(h, [])]
        if not donors or not accs:
            continue
        found = True
        best = None
        for d in donors:
            for a in accs:
                v = xyz[a] - xyz[d]
                L2 = float(np.dot(v, v))
                if L2 < 1e-6:
                    continue
                w = xyz[h] - xyz[d]
                t = float(np.dot(w, v)) / L2
                perp = float(np.linalg.norm(w - t * v))
                dh = float(np.linalg.norm(w))

                info = (ok, max(dh, ah),
                        f"H{h + 1} between {rxn.symbols[d]}{d + 1} and {rxn.symbols[a]}{a + 1}: "
                        f"d(H-donor)={dh:.2f} A, d(H-acceptor)={ah:.2f} A, "
                        f"projection t={t:.2f}, off-line distance {perp:.2f} A, angle D-H-A={ang:.0f} deg")
                if best is None or (ok and not best[0]) or (ok == best[0] and info[1] < best[1]):
                    best = info
        if best is not None and not best[0]:
            return False, best[2]

        return True, "rule not applicable"

rule: The forming and breaking bonds should be elongated beyond typical equilibrium bond lengths for that element pair (for example, at least about 10–15% longer than the longer of the reactant and product values for that bond) so the geometry is not simply a reactant or product structure.
name: discovered_1

rule: For a reaction with a single forming or breaking bond between a pair of atoms, the TS bond length should lie near a sensible fraction of the way between the reactant and product values, and the sum of the fractional progress of all breaking bonds should be roughly comparable to that of all forming bonds, which keeps the TS from being strongly early or late on only one side.
name: discovered_2

rule: A transferring atom (such as H moving between two heavy atoms) should have its breaking and forming bond lengths both stretched, and the donor–H–acceptor angle should be fairly close to linear (roughly 150–180° for intermolecular-like transfers, and not below about 100° in small rings).
name: discovered_3

rule: Ring-forming or ring-breaking reactions should have the atoms of the new cycle arranged so that the reacting atoms are held in close proximity, with the distance between the two atoms that form a new bond smaller than the distance between them in the reactant and each other pair of bonded atoms in that cycle remaining within a plausible range for a strained ring.
name: discovered_4

rule: Atoms that are directly bonded to each other and not part of the reaction should keep their bond angles within a sensible range (for example, sp3 centres near 109°, sp2 near 120°, sp near 180°) relative to the reactant and product values, with deviations allowed to grow only for atoms next to the forming or breaking bonds.
name: discovered_5

def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Bond angles at atoms outside the reaction centre stay near reactant/product values."""
    centre = set(rxn.reaction_centre)
    nr = rxn.neighbours('reactant')
    npd = rxn.neighbours('product')
    near = set()
    for a in centre:
        near.update(nr.get(a, []))
        near.update(npd.get(a, []))

    def ang(p, c, i, j):
        u = p[i] - p[c]
        v = p[j] - p[c]
        cs = np.dot(u, v) / (np.linalg.norm(u) * np.linalg.norm(v) + 1e-12)
        return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, float(cs)))))

    worst = None
    checked = 0
    for c in range(rxn.n):
        if c in centre:
            continue
        shared = sorted(set(nr.get(c, [])) & set(npd.get(c, [])))
        shared = [k for k in shared if k not in centre]
        for a in range(len(shared)):
            for b in range(a + 1, len(shared)):
                i, j = shared[a], shared[b]
                ref = [ang(rxn.reactant_xyz, c, i, j), ang(rxn.product_xyz, c, i, j)]
                cur = ang(xyz, c, i, j)
                dev = min(abs(cur - r) for r in ref)
                adjacent = c in near or i in near or j in near
                tol = 40.0 if adjacent else 25.0
                checked += 1
                excess = dev - tol
                if excess > 0 and (worst is None or excess > worst[0]):
                    worst = (excess, c, i, j, cur, ref, dev, tol)
    if checked == 0:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    if worst is not None:
        _, c, i, j, cur, ref, dev, tol = worst
        return False, (f"angle {rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[c]}{c + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} "
                       f"is {cur:.0f} deg vs reactant {ref[0]:.0f}/product {ref[1]:.0f} "
                       f"(deviation {dev:.0f} > {tol:.0f})")
    return True, f"{checked} spectator bond angles are within tolerance"

rule: Bond lengths between atoms that are not changing bonds but are attached to a reacting atom should lie between their reactant and product values (or be slightly changed in a way consistent with a change of bond order, such as shortening for atoms becoming double-bonded), rather than showing arbitrary distortion.
name: discovered_6

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Unchanged bonds on reacting atoms stay near their reactant/product lengths."""
    centre = rxn.reaction_centre
    changed = set(tuple(sorted(b)) for b in rxn.changed_bonds)
    worst = None
    n_checked = 0
    for (i, j), order_r in rxn.reactant_bonds.items():
        if (i, j) in changed or (i not in centre and j not in centre):
            continue
        if (i, j) not in rxn.product_bonds:
            continue
        order_p = rxn.product_bonds[(i, j)]
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        tol = 0.22 if order_r != order_p else 0.18
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp) - tol, max(dr, dp) + tol
        n_checked += 1
        excess = max(lo - d, d - hi)
        if excess > 0 and (worst is None or excess > worst[0]):
            worst = (excess, i, j, d, min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp))
    if n_checked == 0:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    if worst is not None:
        _, i, j, d, a, b = worst
        return False, (f"bond {rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A, "
                       f"outside reactant/product range {a:.2f}-{b:.2f} A")
    return True, f"{n_checked} spectator bonds on reacting atoms within expected range"

def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Unchanged bonds on reacting atoms stay roughly within their reactant/product lengths."""
    centre = rxn.reaction_centre
    changed = set(tuple(sorted(b)) for b in rxn.changed_bonds)
    worst = None
    n_checked = 0
    for (i, j), order_r in rxn.reactant_bonds.items():
        if (i, j) in changed or (i not in centre and j not in centre):
            continue
        if (i, j) not in rxn.product_bonds:
            continue
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        # real TSs stretch spectator bonds next to the reacting centre a lot
        # (bonds to a leaving group or migrating atom can lengthen by ~0.7 A)
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp) - 0.35, max(dr, dp) + 0.75
        n_checked += 1
        excess = max(lo - d, d - hi)
        if excess > 0 and (worst is None or excess > worst[0]):
            worst = (excess, i, j, d, min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp))
    if n_checked == 0:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    if worst is not None:
        _, i, j, d, a, b = worst
        return False, (f"bond {rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A, "
                       f"outside reactant/product range {a:.2f}-{b:.2f} A (with tolerance)")
    return True, f"{n_checked} spectator bonds on reacting atoms within expected range"

rule: A reacting atom whose bond order or hybridization changes (such as a carbon going from sp3 to sp2) should show a degree of pyramidalization at the TS intermediate between its reactant and product values, measured by an improper torsion or the sum of bond angles around it.
name: discovered_7

rule: Torsion angles around bonds that are not formed, broken, or changed in order should stay close to their values in the reactant or product (within about 30–40°), so that substituents far from the reaction centre do not rotate arbitrarily and the TS stays connected to both endpoints.
